body.focus: Fix ISSUE-bd2d6b6a98f48dc6: the dev-chat header session switcher reads as two controls because its glyph is detached (12px icon at left 2px vs label at padding-left:20px, --muted #6b7688 stroke vs --fg #c6cdd8 label, on a .segsel-transparent borderless select). Give the .chrome #insrc-history rule a chip container — subtle border + faint fill + small radius — and reposition the icon inside the new padding so icon, label and arrow read as ONE control. Presentation-only: no markup, behaviour or session-list change; no new asset, symbol or style rule. Keep the two gradient arrow layers and the data: glyph layer intact. Update the existing glyph test to assert the chip (enclosure + icon inside padding) and keep the CSP-vs-declared-image invariant test green.
